office_does: The district court judge hears misdemeanors, traffic infractions, small claims and civil cases up to the statutory limit for the Upper Kittitas County district (Cle Elum, Roslyn, Easton, Ronald, Snoqualmie Pass and nearby precincts).
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Craig Juris, on the Upper Kittitas County District Court since 2022, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Upper Kittitas County District Court judge for four years and a former deputy prosecutor of 22 years, running unopposed.
highlights: Judge for four years; won the 2022 race 2,704 to 2,463 [S1][S3]
22 years as a deputy prosecuting attorney before the bench [S1]
